name: TogglyRollbackRelease
description: Rollback a Toggly release to restore previous feature flag states
helpMarkDown: Rolls back a release, restoring all feature flags to their previous state. Typically used in failure scenarios. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.label: Workspace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select a workspace after choosing a service connection, or type the workspace ID if the list is empty.

inputs.name: applicationId
inputs.label: Application
inputs.helpMarkDown: Used to list environments for this task. Not sent to the rollback API. Select from the list or type the application ID.

inputs.name: releaseId
inputs.label: Release ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The release ID to rollback. Defaults to the variable set by previous tasks.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target environment to roll back. Select from the list after choosing an application, or type the environment name.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.label: Rollback Reason
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional reason for the rollback (for audit purposes)
